Events & roundtables Where ideas, technology and leaders meet.

Orvix runs private roundtables and technical workshops for leaders and engineering teams across the GCC, wider MENA and the United States, and takes part in regional summits.

Format 01 · Roundtables

Private executive roundtables

Closed sessions for CIOs, CISOs and risk leaders on a single topic, such as evidencing AI controls under ISO/IEC 42001 and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework. A small room, held under the Chatham House rule.
